constraints.name: ck_audit_logs_actor_coherence
constraints.def: CHECK ((((actor_type = 'USER'::audit_actor_type) AND (actor_user_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((actor_type <> 'USER'::audit_actor_type) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_audit_logs_attempted_identifier_hmac
constraints.def: CHECK (((attempted_identifier_hmac IS NULL) OR ((attempted_identifier_hmac ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (actor_type = 'ANONYMOUS'::audit_actor_type) AND (result = 'FAILURE'::audit_result) AND (action = 'AUTH.LOGIN_FAILURE'::text))))

constraints.name: ck_audit_logs_target_user_coherence
constraints.def: CHECK (((((NOT (target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'user'::text)) AND (target_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (target_user_id = target_id)) OR ((target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'user'::text) AND (target_user_id IS NULL))) IS TRUE))

views.name: catalog_items_public
views.def:
SELECT catalog_items.id,
    catalog_items.name,
    catalog_items.description,
    catalog_items.category_id,
    catalog_items.cabys_code,
    catalog_items.unit
   FROM catalog_items
  WHERE (catalog_items.status = 'APPROVED'::catalog_review_status);

views.name: providers_public
views.def:
SELECT providers.id,
    providers.legal_name,
    providers.commercial_name,
    providers.identification_type,
    providers.identification_number,
    providers.phone,
    providers.email,
    providers.address,
    providers.contact_name
   FROM providers
  WHERE (providers.status = 'APPROVED'::catalog_review_status);
